summary: Taichung's 2026 plan is now verified from the bureau's own site. Electric scooter, city money only, one amount for all recognised classes: new purchase NT$3,000 (NT$25,000 low/middle-low income). Scrap-and-replace: NT$16,000 for a two-stroke, 13,000 for 1st-3rd period, 10,000 for 4th period, 5,000 for a 5th-period scooter made by end-2015; low-income households get 30,000. Hybrids get half, and only when scrapping. A guardian of a registered child 12 or under gets NT$3,000 more, once per child. The total of city, 環境部 and 經濟部 subsidies cannot exceed the price, or the city cuts its share. You must be registered in Taichung. Invoice and plating in 2026, apply online by 2027-01-10; money is first-come and may run out. The NT$31,500 headline is not official. No 2027 plan found.

findings.subject: 115年臺中市低碳排車輛補助計畫 (official plan)
findings.valueText: Plan exists. Amended text announced 115-06-29 (府授環空字第1150211958號); the amendment changed only clause 7(1) (old scooter must be Taichung-registered, no out-of-county transfer or household-registration move since 115-01-01). Covers electric scooters (經濟部-recognised 重型/輕型/小型輕型) and, new in 2026, hybrid scooters (能源種類 汽油/電能 or 汽油（油電）, excl. 大型重型).

findings.subject: Residency, registration and eligibility rules
findings.valueText: Applicant: citizen aged 18+ with household registration in 臺中市 at application time, or foreign resident-card holder with a Taichung address, or a business registered in Taichung. New scooter newly plated (no transfer history, inheritance excepted) and registered in Taichung. Old scooter Taichung-plated, no out-of-county transfer since 115-01-01, owner's household registration with no out-of-county move since 115-01-01 (unless already in Taichung before then). One subsidy per old scooter; one scooter per person; anyone who got a Taichung or 環境部 scooter/e-bike/bicycle subsidy since 2016-01-01 is excluded. Not eligible: public agencies, scooter dealers, and rental/sharing/lottery use. Businesses buying 2+ need an approved plan.
